dockerfile_dependencies.value: Dockerfile FROM swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/cloud_boostkit/openeuler-22.03-lts-sp4:latest (业务预构建镜像); 5 层 RUN 安装: 1) dnf install gcc gcc-c++ make cmake git python3-pip boost-devel sqlite sqlite-devel curl pkgconfig wget unzip; 2) 源码编译 ragel 6.10 (curl ragel-6.10.tar.gz from buildtools.obs); 3) pcre 8.45 源码预置到 /opt/pcre-8.45 (curl pcre-8.45.zip); 4) boost 1.87.0 源码预置到 /hyperscan/boost_1_87_0 (wget boost_1_87_0.tar.gz); 5) entrypoint 脚本自动 cp -rf /opt/pcre-8.45 /workspace/pcre. 镜像内 OS 与宿主机 OS 均为 openEuler, 无需跨发行版包名映射.

value: CMake 2.8.11 及以上 (必选, 镜像内 3.22.0)
Ragel 6.9 及以上 (必选, 镜像内 6.10)
Boost 1.57 及以上 (必选, 镜像内 1.87.0)
PCRE 8.41 及以上 (可选, hscollider 依赖, 镜像内 8.45 源码)
SQLite 3 (可选, hsbench 依赖, 镜像内 3.37.2)

build_commands.value: sh .gitcode/scripts/build_ci.sh (等价: cd build && cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RELWITHDEBINFO .. && make -j$(nproc)); 前置: 容器启动时 entrypoint 自动 cp -rf /opt/pcre-8.45 /workspace/pcre

ut_commands.value: sh .gitcode/scripts/ut_ci.sh; 5 个测试套件: 1) unit-hyperscan (4133 tests/34 cases), 2) unit-chimera (262 tests/6 cases, 需PCRE), 3) hscheck (2135 条规则, 需PCRE), 4) collide_quick_test (hscollider streaming -t3), 5) collide_quick_test_block (hscollider block); 含 collide 豁免 id 88111
